goal: Keep real-time resize while eliminating a second synchronous geometry read/layout pass from ResizeObserver callbacks.

trace_evidence.vercel: 647 Layout events / 21.3s, 2745ms total Layout, max 55.8ms; many full #document layouts.
trace_evidence.ai_studio_app: 409 Layout events / 29.25s, 2451ms total Layout; profiler overhead present, so used only for stack attribution.
trace_evidence.attribution: AI Studio trace repeatedly attributes expensive layout to LiteStudioSplitWorkspace/StudioSplitWorkspace geometry measurement paths; contentResponsive also appears as a forced geometry read.

changes: StudioSplitWorkspace consumes ResizeObserver borderBoxSize during continuous native resize and keeps cached left/rail geometry until an explicit frame breakpoint or resize-end exact refresh.
LiteStudioSplitWorkspace uses the same observer-width fast path and stops force-broadcasting exact responsive widths every native resize frame.
contentResponsive consumes ResizeObserver borderBoxSize directly instead of getBoundingClientRect inside the observer callback.
No freeze, clipping, body unmount, delayed resize, visual snapshot, iframe, Firebase, Auth, Firestore, Functions, or storage-schema change.
success_test: On Vercel/test build, resize the outer browser window repeatedly across PC/tablet widths and drag the split bar. The panes must continue to resize live; judge only visible stutter/latency versus 683.
